message:
The basic exception works fine. The issue is that `pc` in the callinfo needs to point to one past the end of the iseq. Let me think about when this happens.

When `bar` calls `foo`, the `ci->pc` for `bar`'s frame is set to point to the instruction after the `OP_SEND` call. If `foo` is the last statement in `bar`, then `ci->pc` would point to one past the end of `bar`'s iseq.

But wait - in the trace above, `bar`'s frame shows line 6, which is the `foo` call. So `ci->pc` for `bar` points to the `foo` call instruction, not past the end.

Let me think about this differently. The issue might be with `OP_RETURN` or `OP_TAILCALL`. When a method returns, the `pc` might be set to one past the end. Let me look at how `OP_RETURN` works:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>grep -n "OP_RETURN\|OP_TAILCALL" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/mruby/src/vm.c | head -20</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
